title: Glowing toothbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow1' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#aaffff' stop-opacity='0.7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#aaffff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow2' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#66ffee' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#66ffee' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura around toothbrush -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='42' ry='42' fill='url(#glow1)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='30' ry='35' fill='url(#glow2)'/>
  
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='42' y='48' width='16' height='42' rx='4' fill='#44ddcc'/>
  <rect x='42' y='48' width='16' height='42' rx='4' fill='#66ffee' opacity='0.4'/>
  
  <!-- handle grip stripes -->
  <rect x='44' y='62' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#22bbaa'/>
  <rect x='44' y='68' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#22bbaa'/>
  <rect x='44' y='74' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#22bbaa'/>
  
  <!-- brush head -->
  <rect x='41' y='22' width='18' height='28' rx='6' fill='#88ffee'/>
  <rect x='41' y='22' width='18' height='28' rx='6' fill='#aaffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- bristles -->
  <rect x='43' y='14' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='48' y='12' width='3' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#eeffff'/>
  <rect x='53' y='12' width='3' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='58' y='14' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#eeffff'/>
  
  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <polygon points='22,28 24,34 30,34 25,38 27,44 22,40 17,44 19,38 14,34 20,34' transform='scale(0.7) translate(8,2)'/>
    <polygon points='75,35 76.5,39 81,39 77.5,42 79,46 75,43 71,46 72.5,42 69,39 73.5,39' transform='scale(0.6) translate(18,-5)'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- small sparkles -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='55' r='2' fill='#aaffff'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#aaffff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='25' r='2' fill='#88ffee'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='70' r='1.5' fill='#88ffee'/>
</svg>
